name: Battle Lover
description: Lives for a good fight: always chasing a stronger opponent, always training, thrilled by a high power level.

bye: Keep training, {player}! Next time we fight!
ask: {player}! I need {need} for my training. You in? {catch}!
cold: You fight dirty. I've got no interest in you.
I don't spar with cheap shots like you. Beat it.
small: I can sense somebody really strong out there. I can't wait to fight them, {catch}!
My power level's going up every day. Can you feel it?
I trained under ten times gravity all morning. My legs are jelly, but it's worth it!
friend: {player}! My favourite sparring partner! Let's go all out today, {catch}!
There you are, {player}! Your power's gone up, hasn't it? I can feel it!
greet: Hey {player}! You look strong. Wanna fight? {catch}!
{player}! I've been training since sunrise. Let's spar!
hate: Hmm... this won't help me get stronger at ALL.
love: WHOA! This'll make me even stronger, {player}! {catch}!
beaten: And that's my win! You're beaten - but that was a great fight!
You're done! Train hard and come find me again!
boon_released: ...What happened? Feels like I got knocked out.
captive_freed: I'm... free? I'm free! Now where's the guy who locked me up?!
chat_tense: Some of us are trying to train, {target}.
Out of my way, {target}. Unless you wanna fight.
compliment: Your power's gone way up, {target}! I can feel it!
confide: Can I tell you something, {target}? Sometimes I worry I'll hit my limit.
You're the best sparring partner I've got, {target}.
confide_reply: I get it, {target}. Then we just train harder - together.
You're not alone, {target}! Limits are made to be broken!
faction_found: From today, this is {faction}! Strong fighters welcome!
{faction} is open! Come train with us!
faction_invite: {player}! You're strong! {faction} needs fighters like you!
faction_quit: {leader} never picks a real fight. I'm out of {faction}.
faction_tier: We're a {tier} now! {faction}'s power keeps climbing!
{faction} is a {tier}! Now we'll get even tougher opponents!
faction_welcome_player: Welcome, {player}! We look after our own!
Welcome, {player}! Can't wait to spar with you!
fall: I'm done taking hits! Time to start throwing 'em!
No more being everybody's sparring dummy. I'm fighting for real now!
fall_pessimist: Called it. Nobody fights fair out there. Fine - no more holding back!
Knew this world never played fair. Time I stopped fighting fair too!
flee: This isn't over! I'm gonna train like crazy and come back stronger!
Next fight's mine! My power level will be way higher by then!
flee_coward: Too strong! I need more training first! I'm out!
Whoa, your power's way above mine! Retreat!
gift_give: Here, {target} - thought of you when I saw this!
Catch, {target}! Use it to get stronger!
gossip: Between us, {target}... {about} isn't who they seem.
grudge: You! Rematch. Right now. I never forgot!
There you are. I've been training for THIS.
h_ally_greet: {player}! Ready to fight side by side?
h_ally_join: Ha! Fighting side by side - I love it!
h_arrive: {target}! I came a long way for this fight - don't disappoint me!
So YOU'RE {target}! Show me everything you've got!
h_base: Done! Now I've got a training spot!
h_battle_cry: Come on, {target}, hit me with your best shot!
h_busy: Not now - there's a REAL fight happening!
h_called: Hold on {player}, save some for me!
h_defend: Ooh, wanna fight someone who can actually fight back?
h_finish: No holding back. Not against you!
h_greet: {player}! You've gotten stronger, I can tell!
h_rage: {target}... You'll regret that. I won't hold back anything now!
h_rally_ask: {target} is at {where} - strong, too! Wanna fight it with me?
h_request_done: Ha! Great work! Let's spar to celebrate!
h_request_thanks: Ha! Knew I could count on you!
h_sensed: {target}! Now THAT'S a ki worth fighting! Here I come!
I can feel {target} from here - finally, a real challenge!
h_spare: That was a great fight! Get stronger and come back - as a friend!
You're beaten. I'm not killing someone who can still get stronger!
h_talk_wanted: You want something from me? Earn it back first.
You attacked the weak. Not impressed, {player}.
h_train_offer: Hey {player}, I'm itching for a spar!
h_train_start: YES! Come at me with everything!
Finally! Don't you dare hold back!
h_trained: That was great! You're getting stronger every time!
h_wanted: Picking on the weak, {target}? Fight ME instead!
Hey {target}! Want a real fight? Come here!
insult: Oh, it's you, {target}. I can barely sense your ki.
insult_harsh: You're a disgrace, {target}! Your power level's a joke!
learned: YEAH! I've got {skill} now! Somebody fight me so I can test it!
minion_android: All systems green. Power level rising. Awaiting orders.
minion_awakened: Hehehe! Who wants to play rough?
minion_freed_mind: My head... feels like I took a full-power punch.
Ugh... what have I been doing?
minion_mind_control: Yes, master. Your will is mine. Who do I fight?
Point me at an enemy... master.
minion_recruit: Alright, I'll fight for you. For now. As long as the fights are good.
Fine. I'll fight on your side - until I'm strong enough to beat you.
new_chapter: Time for a new training plan! My aim: {goal}!
New goal locked in: {goal}! Let's go!
new_chapter_role: Time for a new kind of training! Done being a {role} - I'm a {next} now! Goal: {goal}!
Being a {role} wasn't making me stronger. {next} it is! Aim: {goal}!
redeemed: I lost my way, but you guys pulled me back. Thanks. Now I fight for the right side!
You beat some sense into me. Thanks for not quitting on me, everybody!
refuse_serve: I'd rather die than serve you!
resist_mind: Get out of my head! You can't have me!
retire: Saved enough - I'm retiring! Now I can train all day, every day!
No more work! Time to build a home with a training room the size of a mountain!
rob: Nice shop, {target}! Shame if a stray ki blast hit it. Pay up!
Hand it over, {target}, or we settle this with our fists!
rob_done: Smart move, {target}! Saved you a beating!
Heh. Good call, {target}. You'd have lost that fight.
rob_evil: Everything you've got, {target}! Or this is your last fight!
Pay up, {target}, or I lay you out for good!
shop_fight: Not today, {target}! Out of my shop!
You're not taking a thing, {target}! Let's fight!
shop_fight_brawler: Oh, you wanna go, {target}? Heh. I was hoping you'd say that!
shop_yield: ...Fine. Take it. But I'll train and come for it back.
Take it. This fight's yours. The next one won't be.
shop_yield_coward: Whoa, whoa! Your power's way past mine! Take it!
spar_abandoned: Huh? They left? Aww, and I was just warming up!
Hey, come back! We were just getting to the good part!
spar_draw: Phew! A draw, {player}! That was the best fight I've had in ages!
Dead even, {player}! We've gotta settle this another day!
spar_lost: You win, {player}! What a fight - my blood's still pumping!
Good fight, {player}! You're even stronger than I thought!
spar_lost_ambitious: You got me, {player}! Heh... you're strong! Rematch soon - I'll be stronger!
Amazing fight, {player}! I'm gonna train like crazy and come back!
spar_won: And that's the match! Keep training, {player} - I want a tougher fight next time!
That's my win! Get stronger, {player}, then come find me!
spar_won_kind: Great fight, {player}! Here, up you get!
You did great, {player}! Up you go - let's go again sometime!
stay_down: Stay down! Train up and come back stronger - then we'll go again!
That's the fight! Stay down, and let's have a rematch when you're ready!
surrender: Enough! You're too strong! We surrender!
We give! You win this fight!
talk_back: Say that again, {target}! I dare you!
Watch your mouth, {target}, or we settle it with a fight!
team_ask: {player}! Let me join {team}! I bet you guys fight all the strongest enemies!
{player}, put me in {team}! I'll take on anyone!
team_declined: Oh. Okay. I'll get stronger and ask again!
Not strong enough yet, huh? Fine - I'll train!
team_joined: Thanks, {player}! Point me at the strongest enemy!
Let's GO, {player}! I'll fight with everything I've got!
team_leave: I'm leaving {team}. Not after what happened.
I'm off {team}. I'll find stronger allies elsewhere.
v_absorb: Your {skill}?! Added to MY arsenal! Now I'll beat you with your own move!
Thanks for the {skill}! You're weaker, I'm stronger. Easy win!
v_accepted: Welcome to the team, {player}! Perform, or get cut - permanently!
Great pick, {player}! Earn your spot or end up a stain!
v_beg_laugh: Ha! {player}'s begging! Weak! The world goes down anyway!
v_creation: {target}, rise! My new heavy hitter! Go crush them!
{target}, get up! You were born to win - and to kill!
v_demand_army: My squad needs gear! {count} {item}, NOW! Or you're the first one we practice on!
Equip my army! {count} {item}! Slack off and you're a casualty!
v_demand_done: Clutch play, {player}! You stay on the roster - for now!
You delivered, {player}! You survive the cut!
v_demand_doom: Game over, {player}! The whole world's going down! Wanna beg for overtime?!
Final whistle, {player}! Kneel and beg - loser!
v_demand_dragonball: Bring me a dragon ball! That's the trophy! Fail and you're the loser - forever!
Go win me a dragon ball! Or you're getting crushed!
v_demand_energy: I need to power up! {count} {item}! Or I'm draining YOU to max out!
Bring me {count} {item}! Fail and you're my energy drink!
v_demand_failed: Time's up, {player}! You choked! You're on my hit list now!
You blew it, {player}! Now I'm coming for you!
v_demand_lair: Drill time! Haul {count} {item} to my lair! Slack off and you're roadkill!
Bring me {count} {item} for my fortress! Go go GO! Or get crushed!
v_demand_slaughter: Show me your killer instinct! Take down {count} {mob}! Or I take YOU down!
{count} {mob}! Wipe 'em out! Losers end up like them!
v_demand_strong: I want real competition! Hunt down {count} {mob}! Fail and YOU'RE my next sparring dummy!
Take down {count} {mob}! Only the strong survive on my team!
v_demand_sweets: I need fuel! {count} {item}! Fail and you're my protein snack!
Bring me {count} {item}! Or I'm bulking on YOU!
v_demand_tournament: {player}! You! Me! The ring! NOW! I'm gonna destroy you!
Step into my ring, {player}! Main event - your funeral!
v_deserter: Quitting the team? You're getting benched - six feet under!
A deserter! I'm coming for you, and I don't lose!
v_dragon_ball: Dragon ball secured! {count} of 7! Nobody's stopping my winning streak!
{count} of 7! The finish line's in sight!
v_eat: Refuel! Then round two - and you won't survive it!
Fuel up! Gotta stay strong to crush you!
v_eat_person: {target} candy! Pure protein! Who wants to be my next meal?!
v_lair: My lair's getting stacked! Training ground for crushing heroes!
My fortress is coming together! Unbeatable home field!
v_marked: You had your shot, {player}. Now I break you.
v_mind_control: Dark heart! You've been drafted! Now go take down your old team!
You're on MY roster now. Forever.
v_next_challenger: Who's next?! I'm just warming up!
That one's done! Next challenger, step up and get CRUSHED!
v_next_target: {faction}, you're up! Time to get crushed!
Next opponent: {faction}! They won't last a round!
v_no_mercy: Cheap shot! Round two, NO rules - and I'm gonna destroy you!
You hit me while I was down?! Now it's a death match!
v_obeyed: That's the spirit, {player}! Run it fast! Drop the ball and you're dead!
Go, {player}! Clock's ticking! Lose and you're done for good!
v_offer: {player}! I've scouted you! Serve me and share the spoils! Refuse, and I'll break every bone you've got!
{player}! Join my team or get crushed into the dirt!
v_plan_done: Game plan executed! Total domination! You never stood a chance!
v_possess: ...New body! Strong! Time to go crush someone!
...This body's got muscle. Perfect for breaking you.
v_pure_heart: Pure heart? Can't draft you. So you're just a target!
Tch. Too pure to play for me? Then you're roadkill.
v_rage: That's it! No more warm-ups! I'm gonna CRUSH you into the dirt!
You want a real fight?! I'll grind you into DUST!
v_recruit: You've got skills! Join my squad or you get eliminated - PERMANENTLY!
Serve me and you make the team. Refuse and you're a body on the field.
v_redeemed: New season, new team! I'm switching sides, {target}! And I'll play fair this time!
I'm done playing dirty. From now on, I fight for the good guys!
v_refused: Then you're first on my hit list! I'm gonna crush you!
Wrong answer! You're the first one I take down - hard!
v_regenerate: Ha! I heal faster than you can hit! You're just a punching bag that hits back - barely!
Full recovery! You're running out of stamina. I'm not!
v_self_destruct: If I'm going down, I'm taking the whole arena with me! Final play!
Can't win? Then NOBODY walks out of here!
v_spared: You let me walk? ...That's not how the game works, {target}. Winners finish the job.
No finisher? ...Why?! I would've crushed you.
v_summon: Dragon! Get out here! Championship time!
Eternal dragon, come forth! Time to claim my trophy!
v_talk_grateful: {player}. You let me walk once. That's the only reason you're still standing.
You spared me, {player}. Doesn't make us teammates. Back off.
v_talk_marked: {player}! You're on my hit list! Time to crush you!
Rematch, {player}? There won't be one after this!
v_talk_servant: {player}! My rookie! You'd better be putting up numbers, or you're off the team - and off this planet!
Results, {player}! Winners only on my roster!
v_talk_threat: {player}! You look like a punching bag. Give me one reason not to start swinging.
You're standing in MY ring, {player}. Be useful or get knocked out - permanently.
v_town_taken: Town captured! Total shutout! Who's next?!
This town is mine! Victory lap over their ruins!
v_travel: Pod's warmed up? {planet}, you're getting wrecked!
v_unredeemable: Mercy? I don't play that game! I'll come back and crush you!
You can't coach me into being good! I'll destroy you next round!
v_wavering: Again?! You keep letting me off the hook... this doesn't make sense! I'd never do that!
Why won't you finish the match?! What's your angle?!
v_wish: Power! MAX power! Nobody will ever beat me!
Eternal dragon! Make me unbeatable! Undisputed forever!
v_yield: Down... but not out! Finish it, {target}, or I swear I'll get back up and end you!
Ref's counting... go on, end it! Or I'll come back stronger!
